comment: Read against the maker's source at commit 96f186f, "Code cleanup. Release 2.0.3.", which is the last commit whose plugin.json carries the installed version 2.0.3; the next commit bumps it to 2.0.4. The README at that commit is the only manual. Eleven of the sixteen modules carry MIDI on ordinary patch cables under the maker's vMIDI scheme: a three-byte message is packed into a 24-bit integer and written to the jack as that integer negated, so the voltage is zero or large and negative and carries no signal meaning at all (utils/CVMidi.h:68-145). None of those jacks is given a family, because none of audio, cv, trigger or pitch describes what a cable into one carries, and a colour that says "patch a gate here" would be a lie. They are all one channel. RT_TASK_RATE is 4000 in plugin.hpp:54, so every timeout quoted in task runs has been divided by 4000 to get the seconds in the lines; two of the maker's own comments give the wrong figure and are listed on the modules concerned.
